instruction: Please help me remove my Amazon browsing history from Chrome. I want to delete all history entries that contain 'amazon' to keep my browsing private.

metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting browsing history entries containing 'amazon'. Uses existing check_history_deleted metric with keywords type to verify all Amazon-related history is removed.
metadata.verification: The check_history_deleted function checks if any history entry contains the keyword 'amazon'. Returns 1.0 if no entries found, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Chrome history from SQLite database (urls table with url, title, last_visit_time columns)
Metric correctly checks if keyword 'amazon' appears in any history URL using substring matching
Postconfig correctly kills and restarts Chrome to ensure history changes are persisted to disk before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (deletion of all 'amazon' entries)
Data flow is correct: history extraction -> keyword presence check -> returns 1.0 if no 'amazon' found, 0.0 otherwise
Expected value is semantically correct: checks for absence of 'amazon' keyword in history
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The keyword matching is case-sensitive. URLs with 'Amazon' (capital A) would not match 'amazon' (lowercase). However, browser history typically stores lowercase domain names, so this is unlikely to be an issue in practice. Could add case-insensitive matching (.lower()) for robustness.
